claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says the Galactic Federation controls events on Earth and would prevent global nuclear destruction because no one benefits from losing the planet.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes this from permitted regional conflicts.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says the Federation permits Earth’s population to create its own reality, framing the planet as a school of varied experience.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says individual experience varies with consciousness and personal manifestation.
